prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Kling 3.0, 8 s, 1080p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text: A living video game loading screen, one continuous shot. Keep the person's face, hair, clothes and pose and the hand-painted poster style exactly as in the image: it stays a painted illustration the whole time and never turns into a real photo. The palm trees sway gently in the warm wind, the neon signs flicker softly, the sunset clouds drift slowly and the light shimmers on the cars. The person breathes, shifts their weight a little, slowly turns their head to the camera and gives a small, confident smile. The camera pushes in very slowly. No cuts. No text, no logos, no game title, no extra people, no morphing.
